task_description: Create comprehensive integration tests auditing PR 358 chat pipeline: English mode, Assamese mode, RAG fallback to LLM base knowledge, chat response speed test, and lang field override behavior.

verification.summary: All 36 tests pass (19 existing + 17 new) in 1.16s. New tests cover all 5 audit areas: English mode (SSE format, routing, prompt), Assamese mode (routing, Vertex fallback, script), RAG fallback (unavailable, empty, exception), speed (first chunk <200ms, total <500ms), and lang override (en/as/null/invalid). Each test exercises real code paths through the FastAPI endpoint stack with targeted mocks of external services.
